item.title: Make maturity mandatory and spec refinement automatic
item.intent: Remove --quick flag and MATURITY_ENABLED config (maturity always runs). Remove --refine flag and REFINE_ON_EXHAUST config (always refine before final failure). Remove AISHORE_MATURITY and AISHORE_REFINE env vars.
steps: Remove --quick flag from parse_opts in cmd_run_parse_args and all quick_mode references
Remove MATURITY_ENABLED config default and conditional in build_agent_prompt — always include maturity phases
Remove --refine flag from parse_opts and make refine_item_spec always run when retries exhausted
